title: E0052: Unchecked json_decode result
plain_english: `json_decode()` returns `null` when the JSON is invalid. If the result is immediately accessed as an object or array, PHP may produce a warning, exception, or "property on null" error.
why_matters: Malformed input from a request body, file, or external API can cause a runtime failure instead of a clear validation or error-handling path.
